objects.description: [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has masqueraded as a Microsoft Edge DLL.(Citation: Intrinsec_Vidar_April2026) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has masqueraded as MicrosoftUpdate.exe in the %TEMP% folder.(Citation: Unit42_Vidar_July2026)(Citation: QuorumCyber_Vidar_March2023) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has masqueraded as a Notepad++ installer named npp.Installer.x64.zip.(Citation: Logpoint_StealerMalwareFamilies_2024) [Vidar](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S9050) has masqueraded as an executable named Setup.exe that mimics the legitimate Yahtzee application.(Citation: QuorumCyber_Vidar_March2023)
